subject: FinPay - Mutual Action Plan & Buying Process Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lars Jensen <lars.jensen@finpay.com>, Aisha Patel <a.patel@finpay.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: FinPay - Post-call recap + proposed MAP (next steps)

Hi Lars / Aisha —

Thanks again for a productive intro call earlier. Quick recap + proposed mutual action plan so we can align on decision-makers, timeline, and the security/procurement path. Summary below and attached PDF (FinPay_MAP_v1.pdf):

Call highlights:
- Primary use case: customer support automation for high-volume payments disputes (expected 6M messages/month).
- Key decision criteria: latency at scale, on-prem/private deployment option, SOC 2 evidence and contract-level data residency.
- Timeline: target pilot in Q4 with production by Q1.

Stakeholders you identified:
- Economic buyer: Lars Jensen (Head of Payments) — budget owner
- Security: Aisha Patel (Security Lead) — controls & SAQ
- Procurement: procurement@finpay.com — contract & T&Cs
- Technical reviewers: engineering + infra team (we should get a list)

Proposed MAP (attached):
- Week 1: Share MAP + Security SAQ responses (we attach our initial SAQ answers)
- Week 2: Technical deep-dive (Prio: performance on 8k seq, VPC options)
- Week 3: Pilot scope & SOW draft + pricing
- Week 6: Pilot kickoff

Next actions for you (Lars/Aisha):
1) Confirm that this stakeholder list looks right and add any additional reviewers (names + emails).
2) Confirm target decision date / pilot approval window.
3) If procurement requires an initial MSA or security packet delivered to procurement@finpay.com, let us know and we'll route.

Internal note: Rafael and Priyom — please review the attached MAP and SAQ. Rafael, can you draft a short technical annex for the deep-dive showing expected latency vs batch size? Priyom, can you prepare a pilot cost estimate and a SOW template we can use.

Thanks — happy to hop on another sync if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: FinPay_MAP_v1.pdf, FinPay_Security_SAQ_Responses.xlsx

From: Lars Jensen <lars.jensen@finpay.com>

Cc: Aisha Patel <a.patel@finpay.com>, procurement@finpay.com
Date: 2026-08-31T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinPay - Post-call recap + proposed MAP (next steps)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. This matches our internal view. A couple notes from my side:

- Confirming I'm the economic buyer and want to see a clear TCO for pilot -> production.
- Security will be led by Aisha; she's looped here and will send our initial security questionnaire to you.
- Procurement: we typically need an executed MSA before pilot starts, but we can do a limited pilot waiver in a few cases. I've CC'd procurement.

Timeline: target OKR decision by 2026-11-15; pilot ideally starts week of 2026-12-06. If you can get the SAQ and technical annex this week, we can speed internal approvals.

Lars
Head of Payments | FinPay
lars.jensen@finpay.com

From: Aisha Patel <a.patel@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lars Jensen <lars.jensen@finpay.com>, security@finpay.com
Date: 2026-09-01T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinPay - Post-call recap + proposed MAP (next steps)

Marissa / Priyom —

Quick note from security: thank you for the SAQ document. A few follow-ups we need before we move to pilot: 
1) Clarify data retention defaults and whether tokens/raw logs can be disabled for pilot (we need explicit retention settings).
2) We require an incident response SLA and an integration point for our on-call rotation — is that part of your standard enterprise terms?
3) Please provide the completed SAQ spreadsheet with answers in the "FinPay_Security_SAQ_Responses.xlsx" sheet and any evidence links (SOC2 report or compliance page).

If you can send the updated SAQ and a short IR/Security SLAs doc by Friday 2026-09-04, we'll route to procurement.

Thanks,
Aisha Patel
Security Lead | FinPay

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Patel <a.patel@finpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinPay - Post-call recap + proposed MAP (next steps)

Hi Aisha / team —

Thanks for the quick review. I've attached initial SAQ responses (FinPay_Security_SAQ_Responses.xlsx) and a short Security SLAs summary. To address your points:

1) Data retention: we can set default token/log retention to 0 days for the pilot and enable a strict RBAC policy. We'll include the config snippet in the SAQ answers.
2) Incident response: Redwood offers a standard IR SLA for enterprise customers (RTO/RPO details and an on-call integration doc). I'll attach the one-pager.

3) Evidence: our SOC 2 summary and compliance page links are included in the SAQ sheet; full report available under NDA — happy to route to procurement.

Next from our side: Rafael / Nikhil — Rafael, can you prepare the technical annex requested by Lars (latency curve + batch sizing), and Nikhil can help validate performance numbers given FinPay's 8k seq target.

Best,
Priyom
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: FinPay_Security_SAQ_Responses.xlsx, Redwood_IR_SLA_OnePager.pdf
